Recurring guide character: "Sing", a palm-sized creature between a small ape and a squirrel, soft grey-brown fur, very large pure white ears, round dark eyes, a bushy squirrel-like tail, wearing a short indigo linen jacket, a cloth satchel of bamboo slips over one shoulder, and a small glowing golden flower clipped to one ear; Sing is always small in frame, in the lower-left third, watching. No text, no letters, no logos. SCENE: Zhaoyao Mountain at night, the Study shelf. A quiet mountain grove where every tree bears softly glowing golden blossoms that light the forest like lanterns (the Migu trees), dark-veined bark, osmanthus shrubs, a flat stone used as a desk with rolled bamboo-slip books, a brush and an inkstone, a thin waterfall far behind, deep indigo sky with faint stars, the Western Sea as a pale band of mist on the far horizon. Sing stands up on its hind legs beside the stone desk in the lower left, a bamboo slip in its hands, looking up at the elder. Far in the upper background, very small, a faceless cinnabar-red glowing sack-shaped spirit with six stubby feet and four small wings drifts like a lantern (Dandan, the resident musician); it has no eyes and no mouth. Indigo and malachite shadows, warm gold pools of light, calm and focused. Leave the sky and the stone desk area uncluttered so mist, blossom glow and ear twitches can be animated.

youtube.title: Study lofi with Xingxing, who knows your name 🏔 guzheng jazz beats [1 hour] | Classic of Calm No.01
youtube.description:
Study lofi from the Shan Hai Jing (Classic of Mountains and Seas) — Bestiary No.01: the Xingxing, the creature who knows your name.

Tonight Sing goes home. Under the glowing Migu trees of Zhaoyao Mountain, our small white-eared guide meets an elder of its own kind, and brings back an hour of calm for studying, reading and deep focus: jazzy lofi beats with guzheng, pipa, xiao and yangqin colours.

📜 BESTIARY CARD · No.01 · 狌狌 Xingxing
From the Classic of the Southern Mountains (南山經), Zhaoyao Mountain:
「有獸焉，其狀如禺而白耳，伏行人走，其名曰狌狌。」
"There is a beast here shaped like an ape, with white ears. It crawls on all fours and walks upright like a person. Its name is xingxing."
From the Classic of the Regions Within the Seas: South (海內南經):
「狌狌知人名。」
"The xingxing knows people's names."
A small honesty note: in that second chapter the old book describes the xingxing quite differently ("like a pig, with a human face"). The Shan Hai Jing often disagrees with itself. Our Sing follows the white-eared one from Zhaoyao, and keeps its gift for names.
(English renderings are our own. The original text is over 2,000 years old and in the public domain.)

💬 Sing remembers names. Leave yours in the comments and Sing will write it down.

🗳 Every month you choose a future guest in the Bestiary Census (Community tab).

🤖 An honest note about how this is made
The music is generated with open-weight AI music models whose licences allow commercial use, and the artwork with an AI image model. A small human team chooses every track, edits, sequences and masters it, and checks each creature against the original text. Sing's Listening Scroll is our way of saying it: the scroll writes, and we choose. There are no invented "artists" here. This video is labelled as altered or synthetic content on YouTube.

🏔 Classic of Calm — Ancient creatures. Quiet hours.
📚 Study: Zhaoyao Mountain at night · 🌙 Sleep: the Eastern Sea shore before dawn · 🍵 Work: the Huaijiang garden at noon
🔴 24/7 radio on the channel.
